prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, paid media, growth, creative, B2B vs B2C), your budget, timeline, and industry. I can recommend specific firms if you tell me more, but first here’s a quick guide to help you find the best match.

Quick questions
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, etc.)
- Which channels matter most? (SEO, paid search, social ads, content, email, CRO, programmatic)
- Company stage and size? (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Monthly/annual budget range?
- Do you need creative and branding as well as performance marketing?

How to choose an agency
- Fit to goals: look for agencies with case studies showing results for your objective and industry.
- Skill depth: some agencies specialize (SEO, performance media) while others offer full-service creative + media.
- Transparency & reporting: ask for examples of reporting cadence, dashboards, and KPIs.
- Team & culture: who will do the work (senior strategists vs. juniors)? Ask for bios and org chart.
- Tools & tech: which ad platforms, analytics, and CRO tools do they use?
- Contract flexibility: trial projects or short pilots are safer than long retainers.
- References & results: request recent client references and measurable outcomes (ROAS, MQLs, conversion uplift).

Where to find reputable SF agencies
- Clutch.co and G2 (sorted by location + service + reviews)
- Google Maps / local reviews
- LinkedIn searches for agencies and staff
- Industry lists (Adweek, AdAge, The Drum) and awards

Example budget expectations (rough)
- Freelancers/specialists: $50–150+/hour
- Boutique agencies: $5k–20k+/month
- Mid-market/full-service: $20k–100k+/month
- Enterprise/global agencies: $100k+/month

Questions to ask prospect agencies
- Can you show a 6–12 month case study for a similar client and objective?
- Who will be our day‑to‑day contacts and what does the team look like?
- How do you measure success? What KPIs will you report on?
- What’s the proposed timeline and milestones?
- What tools/platforms are included and what costs are extra?

If you want, tell me your goals, budget, and timeline and I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies (with their strengths) that are a good match.
